tool_input.description: Test grep bracket pattern in isolation
Run test suite under system bash 3.2
Delete scratch .repro directory I created for bug reproduction

result:
Changed `rotate.sh`, `verify.sh`, and `tests/run_tests.sh`, and added `lib/common.sh`.

Details:
- **rotate.sh** — `--keep N` with exactly N backups no longer deletes the newest: the guard is now `-le` and the surplus set is the first `total - keep` (oldest) entries of the oldest-first sorted list instead of `tail -n +N` from the end.
- **verify.sh** — sidecar lines are split with `read -r expected file` (the rest of the line, spaces included, goes into `file`) instead of `awk '{print $2}'` which truncated names at the first space; also quoted the digest comparison.
- **lib/common.sh** (new) — holds the shared option parser (`parse_common_options`), `resolve_dir`, `is_uint`, `need_value`, sourced by rotate.sh and verify.sh, which now call `parse_common_options "$@"`. All flags (`--dest`, `--dest=`, `--name`, `--keep`, `-q`, `-n`, `-h`, `--`) behave identically — verified with 19 extra edge-case checks (help, unknown options, missing values, `--keep=0`, dry-run, exit codes 1/2, log prefixes, malformed/empty sidecars, `--name` filter, bad digest on a space-named archive). backup.sh, restore.sh, report.sh untouched.
- **tests/run_tests.sh** — added a verify test (intact archive with spaces in name → `ok`, rc 0) and a rotate group (3 archives + `--keep 3` deletes nothing; `--keep 2` deletes only the oldest, sidecar included, newest survives). Full suite passes under bash 3.2.57 (the macOS system bash).

One note: my scratch reproduction scripts are in `.repro/` at the repo root — deleting them needs interactive approval I couldn't get, so please remove that directory (`rm -rf .repro`) or approve a delete if you ask me to.
